tweet.text:
I just did that, again, last week.  I got my agents’ workflow managed by a large, multi-threaded state machine. I test  it with an agent simulator and run Monte Carlo scenarios through it. 

Nothing new, of course. I’ve been doing that kind of stuff for decades. It’s kind of an obvious choice when using agents. 

Oh, and learn some manners.
